Maokai.summary: He brings sustain, crowd control and an untargetable engage, and his saplings zone you out of the brush you want to control.

Nautilus.summary: It depends on his jungler and ADC; paired with an aggressive ADC like Draven or Lucian he is very hard to contain. In that case play for late game and take Gathering Storm.

Yuumi.summary: The author's permaban: she cannot kill you but neutralizes your lane presence, and with a hypercarry like Twitch she becomes far more useful than you late.

Blitzcrank.summary: The lane is not lost outright, but he makes it hard to do everything you want.

Sivir.summary: Once your W tether is attached, her spell shield cannot block it, so you do not need to wait for her E before engaging.

Pyke.summary: Ban him or Yuumi. He deals too much damage, ults through your shields and heals off your poke with his passive; unless you bully him out or have jungle priority, the lane is usually lost.

Janna.summary: Very easy; before level 6 you are a stronger version of her. If she pokes with W, answer with empowered Q until she is low, since she cannot shield your damage.

Braum.summary: Bully him out; he has no real answer. Watch his Q and keep poking.

Swain.summary: Your strong early damage lets you poke him out; always watch for his E. Take Comet and Scorch, and probably Dark Seal.

Alistar.summary: A good Alistar is a big problem. You can poke him or the ADC with empowered Q, but a Fleet Footwork ADC with his heal out-sustains it. Go Shield or Peel builds.

Morgana.summary: A good Morgana with a good ADC will likely push you out of lane. Stay very aware of her binding and bait it before poking; she has little other lane damage.

Thresh.summary: A skill matchup where you usually hold the edge, though a hyper-aggressive Thresh and ADC are hard to contain. If you win lane, a damage build is an option; if you lose, go Shield or Peel.

Lux.summary: Watch her Q closely; she usually uses E on your ADC. Poke with empowered Q or bait her cooldowns, and avoid holding your W tether while her Q is up. Take Comet unless your comp is late-game.

Lulu.summary: Her big shields and peel make her hard to poke out, and she becomes more useful late with strong ADCs. Take Gathering Storm with a Peel or Shield build.

Milio.summary: His utility and passive damage boost for his ADC are overwhelming early and worse late. Ban him if your ADC is weak early; lanes like Milio with Kog'Maw are miserable.

Amumu.summary: His long Q range and all-ins are tough. Play behind minions and poke with empowered Q while watching his bandage.

Bard.summary: Easy to fight in lane with your early damage, but you cannot match his fast roams. Look for low-risk, high-reward plays and early roams of your own.

Brand.summary: Empowered Q gives you range to poke him safely, and he has no sustain. When you W him, watch his Q and use your E speed to dodge if your ADC does not need the shield.

Heimerdinger.summary: His turrets zone you and deny brush control and poke. With an Ezreal it is manageable since he clears turrets; otherwise go Shield or Peel and play for teamfights.

Nami.summary: She is not a big threat herself; your E absorbs her W poke and its speed dodges her Q. Her E empowering her ADC is the danger, so bully the lane but back off when it is active unless they are low.

Poppy.summary: Poke her out with Q. If she is very aggressive, hold R for empowered W when she engages. Ward against her strong gank setup.

Leona.summary: A skill matchup leaning Leona. Spacing is everything: close enough to damage, far enough to avoid her CC, especially her E gap closer. Bully her out early to keep her out of the game.

Rakan.summary: Leans in your favor. His W is slow and predictable to dodge; his Q heals off your poke and his ult is hard to avoid.

Rell.summary: She has no damage, so you have strong kill pressure on her ADC. Poke her out, but positioning badly can turn it into a coin flip.

Renata.summary: She does little; poke her and dodge her Q with E speed. Watch her W, which can turn fights.

Senna.summary: Your damage outpokes her sustain early; try to end before a long game favors her.

Seraphine.summary: Lane is easy, but late her Moonstone plus W is unmatched. Poke her out and try to win quickly.

Sona.summary: The most even skill matchup; watch her ult closely.

Soraka.summary: Dodge her Q above all; without it she is useless early. Poke her, but do not rely too much on E speed since she can silence you.

Zyra.summary: Her plants are a big problem for you. Go Shield or Peel and play for teamfights and jungle plays.

Zilean.summary: Weak before level 6 but very hard to fight afterward.
